newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S QUAESTOR STARTS PUBLIC SHARE OFFER.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S QUAESTOR STARTS PUBLIC SHARE OFFER.

text.p: Hungary's Quaestor Securities and Investment Rt said on Tuesday it had opened subscriptions for its own shares today.

The new shares target primarily Quaestor's clientele of 30,000 investors who have signalled their interest in not only using the Quaestor group's services but in buying stakes in it, Csaba Tarsoly, Quaestor's Chairman told a news conference.
"We wish to provide investment opportunities to our loyal investors," Tarsoly said.

Quaestor, the first brokerage to list its own shares on the Budapest Stock Exchange, will issue new 1,000-forint face value series "A" ordinary shares shares worth between a nominal 100 million and 500 million forints, at 2,500 forints per share.
It will also issue one single series "B" preference share to be subscribed by Quaestor Financial Consultancy Rt, its current sole shareholder.

Should subscriptions come in at the upper end of the offer, the issue will bring Quaestor's issued share capital to at least one billion forints, the minimal capital necessary to form an investment company under Hungary's recently passed new securities bill.
"The share issue aims at transforming Quaestor to an investment company," Tarsoly said, adding they aim at acquiring different manufacturing companies eventually.

Tarsoly said he expected the new shares to benefit from the rising trend of the Budapest bourse which saw its BUX index rise more than 2,000 points this year to a new all-time high of 3,760.99 points today.
"We hope that the new paper will be able to ride the tide of the market," Tarsoly said. "We plan modest dividend payouts, but we would like our investors to receive extras from the price rise."
The chairman said he expected the Budapest bourse's council to discuss Quaestor's application at its meeting in January.
